title: Those Who Serve: 10% off each line
details: 10% off the base monthly rate of each eligible line for military, first responders, nurses (RN, LPN, LVN and nurse practitioners) and teachers. Verification documents required.

title: Students: 10% off each line
details: 10% off each eligible line for students enrolled at a U.S. college, including online. The student must be the account owner or manager. Lasts up to 4 years with yearly checks.

title: Appreciation Savings: up to 20% off
details: For active-duty military, veterans, teachers, retired first responders and their families: 20% off Premium 2.0, 15% off Extra 2.0 and 10% off Value 2.0 lines. Proof of eligibility required. Active first responders are pointed to FirstNet instead.

title: 55+: two lines for $30 each
details: The Essentials Choice 55 2.0 plan is $30/mo per line with two lines, for customers 55 and older. Up to 2 lines can be ordered online.

title: Military: save on Experience plans
details: Military and veteran families save $720 a year with 4 lines on Experience plans. The military member must be the account holder and verify within 45 days, or the price goes up by up to $20 per line.

title: Work Perks: 15% off Experience plans
details: 15% off Experience More or Experience Beyond (with AutoPay) on up to 5 voice lines through participating employers. Starts 1–2 bills after your employment is verified.

title: Employer discounts
details: Verizon has discounts for employees of partner companies and organizations. Check eligibility with your work email.

title: Lifeline: federal help for low-income households
details: Lifeline is a federal FCC benefit that lowers the monthly cost of phone or internet service for eligible low-income households. Verizon offers it through some prepaid brands (Tracfone, SafeLink Wireless and Walmart Family Mobile). T-Mobile points eligible California residents to Assurance Wireless.
